finding: P1: collection-level visibility bypasses protected Body checks
implementation: Reject unsupported collection/view-layer visibility affecting modeled objects, including ancestors and inactive view layers, before snapshot comparison or success evidence. Default visible nested collections remain supported.
correctedHarnessFailures: Initial render probe used BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT; Blender 5.1 uses BLENDER_EEVEE. Probe now selects the available engine.
Initial alpha probe used a stepped bpy pixels slice; probe now copies pixels before slicing.
limitations: Conservative blocker: nondefault collection/view-layer visibility affecting model objects requires explicit conversion before protected editing, including when object visibility edits are authorized.
Deterministic real Blender checks and revalidation of four existing live outputs; no new Codex/image generation or human review performed.
